senses.gloss: one of the brothers that accompanied the Ark to Gibeah.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 21:1">Num. R. s. 21</cite>; a. e.—2) name of a fallen angel.
<cite ref="Yoma 67b:7">Yoma 67ᵇ</cite> <he>מעשה ע׳ ועזאל</he> the deed of U. and Azael (who came down and had connection with the daughters of man, v.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 6:4">Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 4</cite>).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 34:1">Pesik. R. s. 34</cite> <he>ומה עזא ועזאל וכ׳</he> when U. a. Azael … sinned on coming down &c.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:11">Deut. R. s. 11</cite>, end <he>עזה ועזאל</he>.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 44:1">Yalk. Gen. 44</cite> <he>שמחזי ועזאל</he>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 6:4">Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 4</cite> <he>שמחזי ועוזיאל</he>.]
